request.text: Two gotchas found by running `closing-campaign` for real on campaign #6. **Step 2 reported two false blockers on a campaign whose work was fully landed.** `git branch --no-merged` walks ancestry, and a squash merge writes a new commit onto the base, so the topic branch never becomes an ancestor. Paired with `--delete-branch`, the local branch is also gone from the remote — the exact signature step 2 exists to catch. Squash is the default merge here, so this fires on every ordinary campaign, and a close that trusted the reading would refuse for no reason. The discriminator is content, not ances
request.title: closing-campaign: tell a squash-merged branch from work that exists only here
